title: Man shot by police identified
article: Reuben Simeon Coleman, 21, has been identified as the man fatally shot Monday by police at East 41st Avenue and Knight Street in Vancouver.
Const. Tim Fanning, of Vancouver police, said Coleman was known to police.
Coleman did not reside at a fixed address, he added, but has lived in the Abbotsford area.
He was shot after getting into a struggle with a police officer and allegedly pulling out a handgun and firing several shots.
The officer was able to break away and shoot Coleman with his gun.
